title: Karlsson-on-the-Roof
author: Astrid Lindgren
short_summary: A lonely boy nicknamed Kid gets an unexpected friend: Karlsson, a small, plump, self-important man who lives in a hidden house on the roof and flies using a propeller strapped to his back. Karlsson calls himself "the world's best" at everything, and constantly pulls Kid into mischief and wild pranks around the apartment building.
extended_summary:
A lonely boy nicknamed Kid gets an unexpected friend: Karlsson, a small, plump, self-important man who lives in a hidden house on the roof and flies using a propeller strapped to his back. Karlsson calls himself "the world's best" at everything, and constantly pulls Kid into mischief and wild pranks around the apartment building.

Karlsson's pranks often get Kid into trouble with his parents, since no one else ever sees Karlsson or believes he's real. But underneath the boasting and mischief, Karlsson's friendship gives Kid something he was missing — someone who always wants to play, and who makes even ordinary days feel like an adventure.
